name: io.github.WYRE-AI/td-synnex-mcp
title: TD SYNNEX StreamOne ION
description: TD SYNNEX StreamOne ION v3: customers, products, pricing, orders, subscriptions, carts. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: StreamOne ION reseller account id (ION portal: Quick Access > Account Information)

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: StreamOne ION OAuth refresh token (ION portal: Settings > Users > Edit > OAuth credentials > Request New Credentials). Single-use and rotating; pair with TDSYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN_FILE to persist the rotated token. Set this, TDSYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN_FILE, or TDSYNNEX_ACCESS_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of a file holding the current refresh token. Read at first use (wins over TDSYNNEX_REFRESH_TOKEN) and rewritten atomically (mode 0600) after every token rotation.

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Static access (bearer) token, valid 2 hours and not renewed. Ignored when a refresh token or token file is set.

environmentVariables.name: READ_ONLY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Read-only by default: write tools are not listed and are refused. Only the exact value 'false' enables writes (customers, carts, orders; orders and cancellations also need preview/confirm).

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_MAX_ORDER_LINES
environmentVariables.description: Local cap on order lines per order or checkout (not a TD SYNNEX limit)

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_MAX_LINE_QUANTITY
environmentVariables.description: Local cap on quantity per order line (not a TD SYNNEX limit)

environmentVariables.name: TDSYNNEX_CONFIRM_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: HMAC key (at least 32 bytes) for order confirm tokens. If unset a random per-process key is used and tokens do not survive restarts.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source for HTTP: 'env' reads TDSYNNEX_* locally, 'gateway' requires X-TDSynnex-Account-Id and X-TDSynnex-Access-Token headers from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
